Elena Park: Heads-up — Borealis account flagged by health monitor. Weekly active tokens down ~60% WoW; active seats 30 -> 8. CRM note: procurement contact moved to Ops lead last week and customer started a 2-week POC with EmberAI. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/Borealis/health
Jordi Alvarez: Oof. Any infra or error signals? latency/p95 changes?
Elena Park: infra clean. No error spikes. Drop starts 2026-08-03. Got a quick customer note: "We're running a short POC with EmberAI focused on extraction accuracy — will evaluate after 2 weeks."
Mina Shah: ok so risk = usage drop + stakeholder change + competitor POC. Recommend playbook: 1) 15-min discovery with new Ops lead, 2) offer 2x15m hands-on sessions demonstrating parity on extraction flow, 3) 45-day seat credit + migration assist if they commit.
Carlos Vega: can someone pull a seat-level rollup + last-14-day token trend and top 5 users? I want a one-pager for the execs. SQL I can use:
```
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) AS active_seats, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE org = 'borealis' AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC;
```
Carlos Vega: running the query now. Quick read: tokens drop begins 2026-08-03; top user activity drops to near-zero same day. No p95 latency drift. Behavior change likely.
scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Borealis - quick recovery sync" on 2026-08-09 11:00 PT — invites: Ops lead, Elena, Mina, Carlos :calendar:
Jordi Alvarez: I'll draft a 1-slide ROI snapshot calling out token efficiency and two quick wins. Mina, can you own the pricing/credit language?
Mina Shah: yep. Proposal: 45-day seat buffer + one-time migration assist credit (2 office-hours) + optional 10% discount on a 6-month renewal if usage recovers within 60 days.
Elena Park: drafting a short outreach to Ops lead (3 bullets): 1) quick readout of observed drop, 2) ask about EmberAI pilot goals + blockers, 3) offer 15-min discovery + 2x15m hands-on sessions + seat buffer. Sending now. :mailbox_with_mail:
Carlos Vega: action items: A) outreach (Elena), B) infra/usage brief + top-user list (Carlos), C) pricing / credit proposal (Mina), D) ROI slide (Jordi). Timeline: outreach EOD, infra brief by EOD tomorrow, pricing deck before meeting.
Mina Shah: noted. Also suggest we shadow EmberAI POC if possible — ask Ops lead for test dataset or specific eval metrics so we can mirror.
Jordi Alvarez: good idea — that'll make the hands-on more relevant.
Elena Park: will request POC goals & sample data in outreach. Keep this high-touch for now. :eyes:
Mina Shah: thumbs up.
